quoted_for_design.claim: 任意の部分一致検索には trigram トークナイザの FTS5 を検討でき、連続する3文字以上の非ワイルドカード Unicode 文字を含むパターンを最適化できる
quoted_for_design.verbatim: For arbitrary substring searches, consider FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer, which can optimize patterns containing at least three consecutive non-wildcard Unicode characters.

quoted_for_design.claim: FTS5 索引は保存量と書き込み費用を増やすため、自分の負荷で計測すること
quoted_for_design.verbatim: FTS5 indexes increase storage and write costs, so benchmark them for your workload.

quoted_for_design.claim: どちらの手も EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN で確かめること
quoted_for_design.verbatim: Verify either approach with EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN.
